Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

NanoQuRe (development version)

Data integrity

  • pore_activity_heatmap() places channels at their correct flow cell position, keeps every base in the time panel, and stops on channel numbers outside the selected platform.
  • plot_quality_distribution() shows reads of any Q-score; reads above Q15 were previously hidden.
  • plot_double() reports the true minimum read length.
  • plot_seq_throughput() and plot_average_speed() show hours without reads as zero yield and as gaps, instead of joining them with a line.
  • generate_report() stops on missing sample_id or passes_filtering values and reads identifiers as text.

Reports and plots

  • generate_report() works from read-only libraries.
  • Report captions describe each plot and give values computed per sample, without fixed conclusions.
  • plot_read_lengths() draws a binned histogram on a log10 axis by default; new weight = "bases" and log_x arguments.
  • plot_active_channels() counts channels with a read in each 10-minute window; new bin_width argument.
  • The unused scales dependency is removed.
